Bug_Title: "@Controller" classes that use "@SessionAttributes" must call "setComplete" on their "SessionStatus" objects
Bug_Explanation: The @Controller uses @SessionAttributes to store session data but does not call setComplete on the SessionStatus object to clean up the session data after use. This can lead to memory leaks or stale data being retained.
Trigger_Explanation: The testShowBug method calls the showBug method, which in turn calls the greet method of the HelloWorld class where the @SessionAttributes is used without a corresponding call to setComplete on the SessionStatus object. This triggers the bug as the session data is not cleaned up.
